oidc.title: OpenID Connect
oidc.description: Any provider that speaks OpenID Connect, such as Keycloak, Authentik, Entra ID, Google or Okta. Register the redirect address <public address>/auth/oidc/callback with it.

issuer.title: Issuer
issuer.description: The https:// address of the provider, exactly as it states it itself. Its description is read from <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: openid is always asked for. profile adds a name for new users.

allowSignup.title: Create a user for an account nobody has linked
allowSignup.description: Off: such an account is refused until an administrator links it. On: it gets a new user without any role.

twitch.title: Twitch
twitch.description: Register an application at dev.twitch.tv/console with the redirect address <public address>/auth/twitch/callback.

allowSignup.title: Create a user for an account nobody has linked
allowSignup.description: Off: such an account is refused until an administrator links it. On: every Twitch account gets a new user without any role.

discord.title: Discord
discord.description: Register an application at discord.com/developers/applications with the redirect address <public address>/auth/discord/callback.

allowSignup.title: Create a user for an account nobody has linked
allowSignup.description: Off: such an account is refused until an administrator links it. On: every Discord account gets a new user without any role.
